headline: Backup Report for Collin County Homes
summary: Collin County has a moderate outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 11 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 34% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 54 hours. In May 2024, 23% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 45 hours. One Core lasts about 15 hours in August. One Core lasts about 38 hours in February. Two Cores last about 24 hours in August. Two Cores cover 95% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours for homes in Collin County with gas heat. Base confirms sizing at install.
